name: cpu-prime-count-v1
description: Reference contract for prime counting. A hand-written contract used to prove the gate itself before any synthesized adapter is trusted. Every contract ships a known-good and a known-bad; the gate must accept the good and reject the bad.

known_good.source:
def primes(n):
    def is_p(k):
        if k < 2: return False
        if k == 2: return True
        if k % 2 == 0: return False
        d = 3
        while d*d <= k:
            if k % d == 0: return False
            d += 2
        return True
    return [p for p in range(2, n) if is_p(p)]

known_bad.reason: returns evens, not primes — must be rejected
